game.title: Penalty King
game.tagline: Five kicks each. One cup. Be the king!
mode.cup.help: Lead Lagoon Lanterns through three shootouts to lift the cup.
mode.quick.help: One shootout against the rival you choose.
mode.practice.help: Kick as many as you like. Nothing is scored or saved.

game.howto.1: Shooting: swipe up from the ball. The end of your swipe is where the ball goes, and a faster flick is a harder shot. Bend your swipe into a curve to bend the ball.
game.howto.2: Power has five zones: Soft, Good, Sweet, Hard and Over. Sweet is the most accurate. Hit it too hard and the ball sails over the bar.
game.howto.3: Keeping: when the rival runs up, tap one of the six dive buttons, or swipe across them. Dive early to reach a corner, or wait to read the ball and risk being too late.
game.howto.4: A shootout is five kicks each. It ends early when one side cannot catch up. If it is level after five, sudden death: one kick each until someone leads.
game.howto.5: Cup: win three shootouts (quarter-final, semi-final, final) to be champion. Quick match is one shootout. Practice is unscored. Rivals read your favourite corners, so mix it up.
game.howto.6: Keyboard: arrow keys aim, Z and X curl the ball, Space starts the power meter and Space again kicks. To dive, arrows pick a button and Enter dives. P pauses.
hint.swipe: Swipe up from the ball, a bit longer.
